text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2013.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2013

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi enam ratus tiga puluh enam juta satu

ratus empat puluh ribu ringgit (RM636,140,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Rancangan

Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2013 sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 146,471,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 180,993,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap RM 1,564,000

dan bayaran lain

Perbelanjaan lain RM 37,686,000

Hartanah, loji dan peralatan RM 269,426,000

___________________

Jumlah RM 636,140,000

Dibuat 25 Julai 2013

[KSM/PUU/T/01/01/01 Jld.3; PN(PU2)58/XVII]

DATUK RICHARD RIOT JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security Act

1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2013.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2013

2. A sum not exceeding six hundred and thirty six million and one hundred and

forty thousand ringgit (RM636,140,000) shall be issued out of the Social Security Fund

for expenditure on the administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the year 2013

as provided in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 146,471,000

Supplies and services RM 180,993,000

Grants, fixed payments and other RM 1,564,000

payments

Other expenditures RM 37,686,000

Landed property, plant and equipment RM 269,426,000

___________________

Total RM 636,140,000

Made 25 July 2013

[KSM/PUU/T/01/01/01 Jld.3; PN(PU2)58/XVII]

DATUK RICHARD RIOT JAEM

Minister of Human Resources
